      OR ("itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."state" = 'recorded' AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."document"->>'kind' = 'operations_section' AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."document"->>'section' = "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."section"
        AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."document"->>'proofSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."recorded_at" >= "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."created_at"
        AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_diagnosis_reads"."document"::text) <= 4096))) IS TRUE

operations_diagnosis_result_binding.name: operations_diagnosis_result_binding
operations_diagnosis_result_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."run_id"::text AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"->>'fence' = "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."fence"::text
  AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"->>'checkpointId' = "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."checkpoint_id" AND "itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"->>'observationSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_diagnosis_results"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

operations_restore_plan_binding.name: operations_restore_plan_binding
operations_restore_plan_binding.value:
(("itervane"."operations_execution_intents"."restore_plan" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_execution_intents"."restore_plan_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_execution_intents"."restore_plan"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_execution_intents"."restore_plan_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_execution_intents"."restore_plan"::text) <= 4096)) IS TRUE

operations_execution_lifecycle.name: operations_execution_lifecycle
operations_execution_lifecycle.value:
(("itervane"."operations_executions"."state" = 'reserved' AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."blocked_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_executions"."state" = 'blocked' AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."closed_at" >= "itervane"."operations_executions"."created_at" AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."blocked_reason" IN ('approval_revoked', 'proposal_expired', 'restart_not_sent'))
    OR ("itervane"."operations_executions"."state" = 'recovered' AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."closed_at" >= "itervane"."operations_executions"."created_at" AND "itervane"."operations_executions"."blocked_reason" IS NULL)) IS TRUE

operations_health_sample_binding.name: operations_health_sample_binding
operations_health_sample_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."sequence" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."binding_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."binding"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."binding"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."environment_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."binding"::text) <= 2048 AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."recorded_at" >= "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."probe_started_at") IS TRUE

operations_health_sample_signal.name: operations_health_sample_signal
operations_health_sample_signal.value:
("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'evidenceSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"::text) <= 512 AND (
      ("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'status' = 'healthy' AND NOT ("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal" ? 'reason'))
      OR ("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'status' = 'unhealthy' AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."incident_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'reason' IN ('runtime_stopped', 'application_unhealthy'))
      OR ("itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'status' = 'unavailable'
        AND "itervane"."operations_health_samples"."signal"->>'reason' IN ('ingress_unavailable', 'probe_identity', 'komodo_unavailable', 'target_changed'))
    )) IS TRUE

operations_incident_monitor_policy.name: operations_incident_monitor_policy
operations_incident_monitor_policy.value:
"itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."locale" IN ('en', 'zh-CN')
    AND "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."enrollment_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."mapping_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."provider_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."valid_until" > "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."created_at"
    AND ("itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."revoked_at" >= "itervane"."operations_incident_monitors"."created_at")

operations_incident_lifecycle.name: operations_incident_lifecycle
operations_incident_lifecycle.value:
("itervane"."operations_incidents"."unhealthy_samples" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_incidents"."last_unhealthy_at" >= "itervane"."operations_incidents"."opened_at" AND (
    ("itervane"."operations_incidents"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_incidents"."closed_reason" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_incidents"."closed_at" >= "itervane"."operations_incidents"."last_unhealthy_at" AND "itervane"."operations_incidents"."closed_reason" IN ('recovered', 'target_changed'))
  )) IS TRUE

operations_incident_diagnosis_stop.name: operations_incident_diagnosis_stop

operations_incident_operator_record.name: operations_incident_operator_record

operations_observation_binding.name: operations_observation_binding
operations_observation_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_observations"."fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."binding_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."operations_observations"."run_id"::text AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."document"->>'fence' = "itervane"."operations_observations"."fence"::text
  AND "itervane"."operations_observations"."document"->>'bindingSha256' = "itervane"."operations_observations"."binding_sha256" AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_observations"."document"::text) <= 4096) IS TRUE

operations_proposal_binding.name: operations_proposal_binding
operations_proposal_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_proposals"."created_at" < "itervane"."operations_proposals"."valid_until" AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"#>>'{diagnosis,runId}' = "itervane"."operations_proposals"."diagnosis_run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"#>>'{target,environmentId}' = "itervane"."operations_proposals"."environment_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"->>'proposedBy' = "itervane"."operations_proposals"."proposed_by"::text AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"->>'grantId' = "itervane"."operations_proposals"."grant_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"#>>'{action,kind}' IN ('restart', 'rollback')
    AND "itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"->>'targetProofSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_proposals"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

operations_repair_proposal_binding.name: operations_repair_proposal_binding
operations_repair_proposal_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."valid_until" > "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."created_at"
    AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{diagnosis,runId}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."diagnosis_run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{target,environmentId}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."environment_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{target,releaseOperationId}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."release_operation_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{source,candidateId}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."candidate_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"->>'proposedBy' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."proposed_by"::text AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"->>'grantId' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."grant_id"::text
    AND (("itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."incident_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."sample_sequence" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"->'incident' = 'null'::jsonb)
      OR ("itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."incident_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."sample_sequence" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{incident,id}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."incident_id"::text
        AND "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"#>>'{incident,sampleSequence}' = "itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."sample_sequence"::text))
    AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_repair_proposals"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

operations_request_binding.name: operations_request_binding
operations_request_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_requests"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_requests"."document"->>'version' = '1'
    AND "itervane"."operations_requests"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."operations_requests"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."operations_requests"."document"->>'applicationId' = "itervane"."operations_requests"."application_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_requests"."document"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."operations_requests"."environment_id"::text AND "itervane"."operations_requests"."document"->>'releaseOperationId' = "itervane"."operations_requests"."release_operation_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_requests"."document"::text) <= 4096) IS TRUE

operations_restart_writer_binding.name: operations_restart_writer_binding
operations_restart_writer_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."enrollment_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."installation_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."credential_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'version' = '1'
    AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'installationId' = "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."id"::text AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."environment_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'enrollmentSha256' = "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."enrollment_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'credentialSha256' = "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."credential_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'policySha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->>'rolesSha256' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"->'whiskers') = 'object' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_restart_installations"."document"::text) <= 4096) IS TRUE

operations_restart_recovery_proof.name: operations_restart_recovery_proof
operations_restart_recovery_proof.value:
(("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR (jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof") = 'object' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof"::text) <= 4096
      AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) IS TRUE

operations_restart_recovery_lifecycle.name: operations_restart_recovery_lifecycle
operations_restart_recovery_lifecycle.value:
(
    ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."state" = 'observing' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."completed_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."created_at" AND (
      ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."state" = 'verified' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."state" = 'retry' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."attempt" < 3 AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" IN ('unhealthy', 'unavailable', 'lease_expired') AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL)
      OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."state" = 'manual_review' AND (
        ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" = 'native_unconfirmed' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" IN ('missing_evidence', 'target_changed') AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL)
        OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."attempt" = 3 AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."failure" IN ('unhealthy', 'unavailable', 'lease_expired') AND "itervane"."operations_restart_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL)
      ))
    ))) IS TRUE

operations_restart_baseline_binding.name: operations_restart_baseline_binding
operations_restart_baseline_binding.value:
(("itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."runtime_baseline" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."runtime_baseline_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR (jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."runtime_baseline") = 'object' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."runtime_baseline"::text) <= 2048
      AND "itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."runtime_baseline_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')) IS TRUE

operations_restart_request_receipt.name: operations_restart_request_receipt
operations_restart_request_receipt.value:
(("itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."approval_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."received_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."approval_id" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."received_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restart_requests"."created_at")) IS TRUE

operations_restart_resume_stage.name: operations_restart_resume_stage
operations_restart_resume_stage.value:
(
    ("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."state" IN ('queued', 'blocked') AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."worker_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."fence" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."prepared_at" IS NULL
      AND (("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."state" = 'queued' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."recorded_at" IS NULL) OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."state" = 'blocked' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."recorded_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."created_at")))
    OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."prepared_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."created_at"
      AND (("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."state" = 'prepared' AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."recorded_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."state" IN ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'unknown') AND "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."recorded_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restart_resumes"."prepared_at")))
  ) IS TRUE

operations_restore_recovery_lifecycle.name: operations_restore_recovery_lifecycle
operations_restore_recovery_lifecycle.value:
((
    ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."state" = 'observing' AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."failure" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."completed_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."created_at" AND (
      ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."state" = 'verified' AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."failure" IS NULL AND jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof") = 'object'
        AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof"::text) <= 4096 AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
      OR ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."proof_sha256" IS NULL AND (
        ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."state" = 'retry' AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."attempt" < 3 AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."failure" IN ('update_pending', 'unavailable', 'unhealthy', 'lease_expired'))
        OR ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."state" = 'manual_review' AND ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."failure" IN ('target_changed', 'missing_update', 'update_failed')
          OR ("itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."attempt" = 3 AND "itervane"."operations_restore_recoveries"."failure" IN ('update_pending', 'unavailable', 'unhealthy', 'lease_expired'))))
      ))
    ))
  ) IS TRUE)

operations_restore_step_receipt.name: operations_restore_step_receipt
operations_restore_step_receipt.value:
(("itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."receipt" IS NULL AND "itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."recorded_at" IS NULL)
    OR (jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."receipt") = 'object' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."receipt"::text) <= 4096 AND "itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."recorded_at" >= "itervane"."operations_restore_steps"."sent_at")) IS TRUE

operations_target_binding.name: operations_target_binding
operations_target_binding.value:
("itervane"."operations_targets"."revision" > 0 AND "itervane"."operations_targets"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."operations_targets"."document"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."operations_targets"."environment_id"::text
    AND jsonb_typeof("itervane"."operations_targets"."document"->'whiskers') = 'object' AND octet_length("itervane"."operations_targets"."document"::text) <= 4096) IS TRUE

preaudit_document_binding.name: preaudit_document_binding
preaudit_document_binding.value:
("itervane"."preaudits"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."preaudits"."report_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'id' = "itervane"."preaudits"."id"::text AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."preaudits"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'requestedBy' = "itervane"."preaudits"."requested_by"::text
  AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"#>>'{evaluation,formalScan}' = 'false' AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"#>>'{evaluation,releaseEligible}' = 'false'
  AND octet_length("itervane"."preaudits"."document"::text) <= 65536) IS TRUE

release_candidate_binding.name: release_candidate_binding
release_candidate_binding.value:
("itervane"."release_candidates"."evidence_version" > 0 AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'origin' IN ('trusted_fixture', 'formal_verification')
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->'releaseEligible' = 'false'::jsonb
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'evidenceVersion' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."evidence_version"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'taskId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."task_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"#>>'{target,applicationId}' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."application_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"#>>'{target,environmentId}' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."environment_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."release_candidates"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

release_operation_observation.name: release_operation_observation
release_operation_observation.value:
(
    ("itervane"."release_operations"."state" <> 'verified_fixture' AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation" IS NULL) OR
    ("itervane"."release_operations"."state" = 'verified_fixture' AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'origin' = 'trusted_fixture'
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'operationId' = "itervane"."release_operations"."id"::text
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."release_operations"."environment_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->'healthy' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->'accessProtected' = 'true'::jsonb
      AND octet_length("itervane"."release_operations"."observation"::text) <= 4096)
  ) IS TRUE

rule_package_activation_binding.name: rule_package_activation_binding
rule_package_activation_binding.value:
("itervane"."rule_package_activations"."sequence" > 0 AND "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."version_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."request_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND CASE WHEN "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."action" = 'withdraw'
      THEN "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."review_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."review_sha256" IS NULL
      ELSE "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."action" IN ('publish', 'rollback') AND "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."review_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."rule_package_activations"."review_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    END) IS TRUE

rule_package_review_document.name: rule_package_review_document
rule_package_review_document.value:
("itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."version_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."outcome" IN ('accepted', 'changes_requested') AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'formatVersion' = '1'
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'kind' = 'design_review' AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'outcome' = "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."outcome"
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'versionId' = "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."version_id"::text AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'versionSha256' = "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."version_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'reviewedBy' = "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."reviewed_by"::text AND "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"->>'grantId' = "itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."grant_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."rule_package_reviews"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

rule_package_version_document.name: rule_package_version_document
rule_package_version_document.value:
("itervane"."rule_package_versions"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND length("itervane"."rule_package_versions"."version") <= 32
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."version" ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"->>'formatVersion' = '1' AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"->>'kind' = 'design_skill'
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"->>'packageKey' = "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."package_key" AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"->>'version' = "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."version"
    AND "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"#>>'{scope,kind}' = CASE WHEN "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."project_id" IS NULL THEN 'workspace' ELSE 'project' END
    AND ("itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"#>>'{scope,projectId}') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "itervane"."rule_package_versions"."project_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."rule_package_versions"."document"::text) <= 61440) IS TRUE

event_actor_kind.name: event_actor_kind
event_actor_kind.value: ("itervane"."task_events"."actor_kind" = 'principal' AND "itervane"."task_events"."worker_id" IS NULL) OR ("itervane"."task_events"."actor_kind" = 'worker' AND "itervane"."task_events"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL)
